senses.en_definition: A conversational particle used to seek confirmation, equivalent to “right?” or a tag question; shortened from bukan.
A conversational particle used to invoke shared knowledge, remind someone of something, or express agreement.
Will; shall; a shortened form of akan, used especially in poetry and song lyrics to mark future action or events.

messages.en: We're meeting in the lobby at nine tomorrow, right?
Yep, the downstairs lobby. Don't go waiting on the third floor!
Okay, got it. I'll get there a little early.

senses.en_definition: The right-hand side or direction, opposite to the left.
Senior; holding a higher rank or position.
Right-wing; following or supporting a conservative political outlook.

messages.en: I'm near the traffic lights now. Do I turn right here?
Yeah, turn right there. Then keep going straight until you see a bakery. I'll be waiting out front.

senses.en_definition: A ship; a large vessel with a deck, usually powered by an engine.
An element in compound names for aircraft and spacecraft, with the following word specifying the type of craft.
A callus; an area of hardened, thickened skin, especially on the feet.

messages.en: Where are you? Hurry up or we'll miss our flight!
I'm in the toilet near the departure gate. I'm just coming out!

senses.en_definition: Captain; a commissioned officer in the army or air force ranking above lieutenant and below major.
Captain; a senior commissioned naval officer ranking above commander and below commodore, equivalent to an army or air force colonel.

collocations.en: the rank of captain in the navy

senses.en_definition: Captain; the senior pilot in command of a civilian aircraft.
Captain; the person in command of a merchant or passenger ship.
Captain; the member who leads a sports team.
Figuratively, a person entrusted with leading an organisation or group.

collocations.en: the person at the helm of a firm

messages.en: Is the captain at the pitch yet? We're about to start.
I'm here. I'm by the side of the pitch, putting my boots on. You lot start warming up.
Okay, captain. You'll split us into teams in a bit, yeah?
